arxiv-2309-16706.title: AIR: Threats of Adversarial Attacks on Deep Learning-Based Information Recovery
arxiv-2309-16706.creator: Jinyin Chen, Jie Ge, Shilian Zheng*, Linhui Ye, Haibin Zheng, Weiguo Shen, Keqiang Yue, Xiaoniu Yang
arxiv-2309-16706.description: Abstract A wireless communications system usually consists of a transmitter which transmits the information and a receiver which recovers the original information from the received distorted signal. Deep learning (DL) has been used to improve the performance of the receiver in complicated channel environments and state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance has been achieved. However, its robustness has not been investigated.

Thanks: 1 The authors are with th
arxiv-2408-08668.creator: Clinton Enwerem, Erfaun Noorani, John S. Baras, Brian M. Sadler
arxiv-2408-08668.description: Abstract With the pervasiveness of Stochastic Shortest-Path (SSP) problems in high-risk industries, such as last-mile autonomous delivery and supply chain management, robust planning algorithms are crucial for ensuring successful task completion while mitigating hazardous outcomes. Mainstream chance-constrained incremental sampling techniques for solving SSP problems tend to be overly conservative and typically do not consider the likelihood of undesirable tail events.

arxiv-2506-15269.title: Ferroelectric switching control of spin current in graphene proximitized by In 2 Se 3
arxiv-2506-15269.creator: Marko Milivojević, Juraj Mnich, Paulina Jureczko, Marcin Kurpas, Martin Gmitra
arxiv-2506-15269.description: Abstract By utilizing the proximity effect, we introduce a platform that exploits ferroelectric switching to modulate spin currents in graphene proximitized by ferroelectric In 2 Se 3 monolayer. Through first-principles calculations and tight-binding modeling, we studied the electronic structure of graphene/In 2 Se 3 heterostructure for twist angles of 0 ∘ and 17.5 ∘ , considering both ferroelectric polarizations.

arxiv-2602-20657.title: Post-Quantum Sanitizable Signatures from McEliece-Based Chameleon Hashing
arxiv-2602-20657.creator: Shahzad Ahmad, Stefan Rass, Zahra Seyedi
arxiv-2602-20657.description: Abstract We introduce a novel post-quantum sanitizable signature scheme constructed upon a chameleon hash function derived from the McEliece cryptosystem. In this design, the designated sanitizer possesses the inherent trapdoor of a Goppa code, which facilitates controlled collision-finding via Patterson decoding. This mechanism enables authorized modification of specific message blocks while ensuring all other content remains immutably bound.

pmc-10700588.title: The inside out model of emotion recognition: how the shape of one’s internal emotional landscape influences the recognition of others’ emotions
pmc-10700588.creator: Connor Tom Keating, Jennifer Louise Cook
pmc-10700588.description: Some people are exceptional at reading emotional expressions, while others struggle. Here we ask whether the way we experience emotion “on the inside” influences the way we expect emotions to be expressed in the “outside world” and subsequently our ability to read others’ emotional expressions.

pmc-11432556.creator: Ryoichi Sato
pmc-11432556.description: Complete elucidation of members of the gustatory receptor (Gr) family in lepidopteran insects began in the silkworm Bombyx mori. pmc-11475940.title: Tissue-Agnostic Targeting of Neurotrophic Tyrosine Receptor Kinase Fusions: Current Approvals and Future Directions
pmc-11475940.creator: Mohamed A Gouda, Kyaw Z Thein, David S Hong, Robert-Alain Toillon
pmc-11475940.description: Simple SummaryThere has recently been an interest in drugs that work across the pan-cancer spectrum and show antitumor activity based on biomarkers rather than histology. In this article, we discuss one of these biomarkers, NTRK fusions, which, if present, can predict sensitivity to treatment with inhibitors of the NTRK molecular pathway.

pmc-11618590.title: Acquiring sequentially time-resolved two-dimensional images with parallel multi-group sampling strategy
pmc-11618590.creator: Yan Song, Bodong Peng, Mei Zhang, Jiming Ma, Liang Sheng
pmc-11618590.description: A method of acquiring sequentially time-resolved two-dimensional images with parallel multi-group sampling strategy has been developed. In this technique, the two-dimensional image was sampled and transferred by a fiber bundle, the fibers of which were arranged in two-dimensional arrays in the input end and rearranged in four one dimensional lines in the output end.

pmc-12733698.title: The Role of Natural Chalcones and Their Derivatives in Targeting Prostate Cancer: Recent Updates
pmc-12733698.creator: Ola J. Hussein, Dana Elkhalifa, Arij Fouzat Hassan, Feras Alali, Ala-Eddin Al Moustafa, Ashraf Khalil
pmc-12733698.description: Prostate cancer (PCa) is the second most prevalent cancer among men and a major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Despite an initial favorable response to hormone-based therapies, many patients ultimately develop an advanced and lethal form of the disease, referred to as castration-resistant PCa (CRPC). CRPC is associated with poor prognosis and a lack of effective curative treatments.

pmc-12751661.title: Patient directed social media use among participants of centering pregnancy groups
pmc-12751661.creator: Alison M El Ayadi, Nadia G Diamond-Smith, Mia Schuman, Laura Weil
pmc-12751661.description: IntroductionSocial support in pregnancy and postpartum is important for optimizing maternal and infant health. Group prenatal care offers the opportunity for in-person social support yet does not extend into the postpartum period. Mobile social support models may further meet the needs of pregnant individuals and partners during pregnancy and into the postpartum period.
